name: Gemini Nanobanana
tagline: AI image generation and editing supporting text-to-image and multi-image composition
description: Gemini Nanobanana uses the Gemini Nano Banana 2 model for AI image generation and editing. It supports text-to-image synthesis, image modification, multi-image composition (up to 14 reference images), Google Search grounding, and custom aspect ratios and resolutions for design and visual content creation.
